clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Redridge Goulash helps feed a town under strain. Chef Breanna fed the active Stormwind garrison during the recent Blackrock orc uprising, emptying her pantry and leaving her to seek hearty ingredients from the mountains.

Lakeshire remains under siege from Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and ferocious wild beasts. When the recent orc uprising began along the ridges, Chef Breanna took on feeding the entire brigade of Stormwind troops stationed in town. Keeping the active garrison fed quickly emptied her cupboards, though the town still had plenty of hungry mouths.

With her cupboards bare, Chef Breanna looks to the dangerous wilderness beyond Lakeshire's gates. Her signature goulash calls for tough mountain condor meat, seasoned snouts from formidable Great Goretusks, and crisp leg meat from giant tarantulas that prowl the hills.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.
Just bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
